description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock Data Automation Runtime service. It extends the AWS SDK's AwsClient and includes method annotations for data automation status checks and invocation, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: BedrockDataAutomationRuntimeClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock Data Automation Runtime service, extending the generic AWS client.

methods.name: getDataAutomationStatus
methods.description: Method to synchronously retrieve the status of data automation.

methods.name: getDataAutomationStatusAsync
methods.description: Method to asynchronously retrieve the status of data automation.

methods.name: invokeDataAutomationAsync
methods.description: Method to asynchronously invoke data automation.

methods.name: invokeDataAutomationAsyncAsync
methods.description: Method to asynchronously invoke data automation with a promise.
